hooks.name: geo-pbt-guard
hooks.description: UNVERIFIED FORMAT: replace with the file Kiro writes when recreated in the Agent Hooks UI. After the agent saves a geo/align/ingest/worker file, re-run the unit and property tests for those folders (path-free, so it does not depend on any file-path templating). Slow suites (bench, real pairs) are excluded here and run in pnpm test and /judge-check. Output, including shrunk counterexamples, goes back to the agent.

action.command: pnpm -s vitest run lib/geo lib/align lib/ingest lib/export workers --exclude '**/bench.test.ts' --exclude '**/real-pairs.test.ts'
